free_tier.stated: 5 GB or 30 million characters per knowledge base, combined across all sources of one bot. One knowledge base per bot.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: Uploads to temporary chats are 'retained for up to 15 days for safety review before being permanently deleted'; regular chats' files are 'permanently deleted within 24 hours of creation'.

egress.terms: No egress concept; bot answers are served by Poe.

interface_detail: Creator UI + `poe-api-wrapper` (unofficial); server bots can accept attachments via `allow_attachments`
tooling: poe-api-wrapper (unofficial Python), fastapi_poe for server bots
chaining: 5 GB per bot, and bot creation is free and effectively unbounded, so each bot holds the same 5 GB allowance. That is the only axis on which the total grows, and it is a manual, per-bot upload loop.
limits_note: per-knowledge-base-cap 5 GB / 30M chars. Uploads to temporary chats are 'retained for up to 15 days for safety review before being permanently deleted'; regular chats' files are 'permanently deleted within 24 hours of creation'.
reliability_note: Knowledge base uploads allow 5 GB per bot with unlimited bot creation. Read access is restricted to model retrieval prompts without documented bulk export endpoints. Rate limits vary by underlying model.
